text:
A metal cup has a plastic lining. The cup is filled with hot water and held by a hand.
Which statement about the transfer of thermal energy from the water to the hand is correct?
A
In the plastic, no energy is transferred directly between adjacent molecules.
B
In the plastic, fast moving molecules interact with free electrons, making the electrons move
very quickly.
C
In the metal, energy is transferred only by electrons.
D
In the metal, energy is transferred by electrons and by vibrations of the lattice.

options.label: A
options.text: In the plastic, no energy is transferred directly between adjacent molecules.

options.label: B
options.text: In the plastic, fast moving molecules interact with free electrons, making the electrons move

options.label: C
options.text: In the metal, energy is transferred only by electrons.

options.label: D
options.text: In the metal, energy is transferred by electrons and by vibrations of the lattice.
